instruction: Cinematic wedding portrait, full-length shot. In a grassy field next to a vintage white car, the bride in a white wedding dress (R1) stands on the left, holding a white bouquet and looking up at the groom in a beige suit (R2). The groom stands on the right, leaning in close to embrace her. Warm golden hour sunlight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the grass.
